title: Planning approved: 3-unit Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) of planning permission HGY/2025/0549 in Tottenham
excerpt: Haringey Council has approved 3 residential units at 196 Page Green Terrace Tottenham London N15 4NP. Local sold-price evidence indicates a median price of £550,000; high-level 70% LTGDV senior debt would be approximately £939,960.
body:
## Tottenham planning approval

Haringey Council has approved planning application HGY/2026/1794 for 3 residential units at 196 Page Green Terrace Tottenham London N15 4NP. The approved proposal is: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) of planning permission HGY/2025/0549 for Excavation of front and rear lightwells and installation of stairs in front garden to basement level, basement extension, single storey rear extension, first and second floor rear extension, installation of waste and bike storage in front garden, reconfiguration and enlargement of existing 3 flats.
Proposed amendment: To increase depth of single storey ground floor rear extension with a conservatory.

The application was decided on 21/08/2026. Construction Capital has reviewed the local market data for Tottenham, Greater London to provide a high-level funding view for the site.

## Local sold-price evidence

HM Land Registry sold-price data for Tottenham shows a median residential sale price of £550,000 across 1,693 transactions in the last 12 months. The year-on-year price movement is +0.9%.

| Recent local sale | Price | Date | Type |
|---|---:|---|---|
| 3, DEVONSHIRE ROAD | £515,000 | 2026-06-26 | S |
| FLAT 5, GEAN COURT, CLINE ROAD | £285,000 | 2026-06-23 | F |
| FLAT 5, 62, SHEPHERDS HILL | £690,000 | 2026-06-23 | F |
| 7C, WOLSELEY ROAD | £802,000 | 2026-06-22 | F |
| FLAT 7, BANK CHAMBERS, 120, HIGH STREET | £288,000 | 2026-06-22 | F |

## High-level indicative development finance

Using the available planning and sold-price data, the scheme has an estimated GDV of £1,342,800. At 70% LTGDV, that implies a high-level indicative senior debt facility of approximately £939,960.

This is not a credit-backed offer and remains subject to valuation, cost plan, borrower experience, planning documentation, lender appetite, and full underwriting. For a live scheme, Construction Capital can approach the lender panel and provide formal indicative terms within 24 hours.
